basic_info_description: Welcome to a fully reimagined residence in the heart of Little Hollywood—one of San Francisco’s most charming and often-overlooked neighborhoods. This stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home has undergone a complete, fully permitted transformation down to the studs, combining thoughtful design, modern luxury, and energy-conscious living in one exceptional package.  From the moment you enter, you're welcomed by a bright, open-concept layout featuring wide-plank flooring, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. The chef’s kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops, and high-efficiency appliances—perfectly tailored for both everyday living and elevated entertaining. All bathrooms have been completely renovated with spa-inspired finishes and contemporary fixtures, delivering both comfort and elegance.  No detail has been overlooked: energy-efficient LED lighting is installed throughout, dual-pane windows offer both comfort and quiet, and every surface has been refreshed with high-quality interior and exterior paint. Additional upgrades include new plumbing and electrical systems, modern doors and hardware, and beautifully landscaped front and back yards—featuring mature fruit trees and a spacious outdoor retreat ideal for hosting, relaxing, or gardening.  Located on a quiet street in the Little Hollywood enclave, this home offers a peaceful residential feel while remaining incredibly convenient—just minutes to Caltrain, Muni, BART, and major freeways. With its strong sense of community, easy access to transit, and proximity to both nature and the city, Little Hollywood provides a truly unique and welcoming lifestyle.  Whether you're looking for a forever home or a long-term investment in one of the city’s most emerging neighborhoods, this is a rare opportunity to own a turn-key property that has it all—style, substance, and location.
